exposure: Mode of delivery (Caesarean section vs. vaginal delivery)
outcome: Incidence of thrombocytopenia in neonatal sepsis
Association between thrombocytopenia and blood culture positivity, mode of delivery, birth weight, and CRP
cohort: 220 neonates hospitalized to the NICU with suspected sepsis before turning 28 days old.
finding: Thrombocytopenia was significantly associated with blood culture positivity, Caesarean section delivery, small for gestational age, and CRP positivity, suggesting it could be an early predictor of neonatal sepsis.
mod_finding: Thrombocytopenia was significantly associated with Caesarean section delivery.
